name: SmartArtNode
description: A single semantic node within the data model of a SmartArt graphic.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtNode object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArtNode object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: OrgChartLayout
properties.description: Retrieves or sets the MsoOrgChartLayoutType associated with this node if there is one. Read/write.

properties.name: Shapes
properties.description: Returns the shape range associated with this SmartArtNode object. Read-only.

properties.name: TextFrame2
properties.description: Returns the text associated with the SmartArtNode object. Read-only.

properties.name: Level
properties.description: Retrieves the node's level in the hierarchy. Read-only.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Returns True if this node is a hidden node in the data model. Read-only.

properties.name: Nodes
properties.description: Retrieves the children nodes associated with this SmartArt node. Read-only.

properties.name: ParentNode
properties.description: Retrieves the parent SmartArtNode of this SmartArtNode. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Retrieves the type of SmartArt node. Read-only.

methods.name: AddNode
methods.signature: AddNode([Position As MsoSmartArtNodePosition], [Type As MsoSmartArtNodeType]) As SmartArtNode
methods.description: Adds a new SmartArtNode object to the data model in the way specified by the SmartArtNodePosition value, and of type SmartArtNodeType.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Specifies the location of the SmartArtNode in the data model; for example, msoSmartArtNodeAbove or msoSmartArtNodeAfter.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of the added SmartArtNode; for example, msoSmartArtNodeTypeAssistant or msoSmartArtNodeTypeDefault.

methods.name: Promote
methods.description: Promotes the current node (and all its children) a single level within the data model.

methods.name: Demote
methods.description: Demotes the current node a single level within the data model.

methods.name: Larger
methods.description: Increases the size of the SmartArt node. Mimics the behavior of the Larger button on the Microsoft Office Fluent Ribbon Format tab for SmartArt.

methods.name: Smaller
methods.description: Decreases the size of the SmartArt. Mimics the behavior of the Smaller button on the Microsoft Office Fluent Ribbon UI Format tab for SmartArt.

methods.name: ReorderUp
methods.description: Swaps a node with the previous node in the bulleted list. This method reorders the node's entire family.

methods.name: ReorderDown
methods.description: Swaps a node with the next node in the bulleted list. This method reorders the node's entire family.
